desc: Derive per-edge XOR-ancestry probabilities for a query \(u<v\), including correlated common-ancestor events when \(i<u\).
Express the expected weighted distance as weighted prefix/range sums using those probabilities.
Convert probability coefficients to modular arithmetic, multiply by \((N-1)!\), and design \(O(1)\) query evaluation.
Prove and validate the formula on small cases, including \(u=1\), adjacent endpoints, and endpoint-edge cases.
Implement the algorithm and verify sample tests, time, and memory bounds.
